archiveConfirm.title: Archive “{{name}}”?
archiveConfirm.body: It will disappear from menus. Past orders are not affected, and you can restore it later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group products the way they appear on the POS and website.
categories.emptyHint: Create your first category, for example “Burgers” or “Drinks”.

products.title: Products
products.description: Prices, sizes, options and kitchen routing.
products.emptyHint: Create a product, or change the filters.
products.needCategory: Create a category before adding products.
products.priceHint: When the product has sizes, each size's price is used instead.
products.skuHint: Optional code, unique in your business
products.variantsHint: Leave empty if the product has a single price.
products.modifierGroupsHint: Options the customer can choose, in this order.
products.stationsHint: The order item is sent to every selected station.
products.overrideHint: Empty uses the group's rule: at least {{min}}, at most {{max}}.
products.overrideInvalid: Check the minimum and maximum for this product

options.title: Options
options.hint: Size, colour, material… Every combination of their values is a variant you can sell.
options.variantsHint: One row for every combination of the options. Untick the ones you do not sell.

barcodes.title: Barcodes
barcodes.hint: Scan or type the codes printed on the product. The first one is primary.
barcodes.duplicate: This code is already in the list.

issues.TOO_LONG: A barcode has at most 64 characters.
issues.CHARACTERS: Use letters, digits and symbols, without spaces.
issues.NOT_DIGITS: An EAN or UPC has digits only.
issues.CHECK_DIGIT: The last digit does not match: check the code.

modifierGroups.title: Option groups
modifierGroups.description: Reusable choices such as doneness, extras or sauces.
modifierGroups.emptyHint: Create a group like “Extras” and attach it to products.

kitchenStations.title: Kitchen stations
kitchenStations.description: Where items are prepared. Each KDS screen shows its stations' tickets.
kitchenStations.emptyHint: Create stations such as Kitchen, Grill, Fryer, Bar or Dessert.

availability.title: Availability & local prices
availability.description: Mark items sold out (86) or set a different price for one location.
availability.noLocation: Choose a location to manage availability.
